principles: process-events.jsonl remains the append-only ledger; capsule is a rebuildable projection.
Evidence and gate receipts remain authoritative; human-readable capsule prose is advisory only.
All paths resolve through configured storyDir and StoryStore so Koala CLI works across repos.
CLI output should help fresh agents resume without requiring full chat or .omx context.
Tests must cover the anti-forgery boundary, not only happy-path display.
drivers: User wants to reduce process/fact fabrication by forcing handoff facts to cite evidence.
Existing Koala lifecycle has owner leases and process-fact registries that new commands must obey.
Two reviewer advisories warn against hardcoded docs/story paths and ambiguous non_authoritative imports.

options.name: projection-capsule-under-storyDir
pros: Allows non-authoritative OMX import without gate pollution
cons: Requires several registry and CLI updates
Needs careful tests around missing references

options.name: make-capsule-authoritative-evidence
pros: Simpler gate lookup for handoff summaries
cons: Violates reviewer guidance and user concern

options.name: leave-in-omx-only
cons: New agents outside OMX still lack handoff state

rationale: Choose a story-scoped projection capsule under configured storyDir. This preserves Koala evidence authority, gives fresh agents a durable handoff, and directly addresses the user concern without making capsule prose a gate bypass.

preMortem.scenario: Capsule path is hardcoded to docs/story/actives and works only in one repo layout.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation copies the proposal text instead of using StoryStore.storyDirPath.
preMortem.consequence: Capsules are missing from Orchestrate worktrees and agents trust stale or absent state.
preMortem.mitigation: Core API resolves all paths from StoryStore/loadConfig; smoke test uses .koala/story/actives fixture.

preMortem.scenario: Forged session-brief.md claims DONE-ready and bypasses evidence checks.
preMortem.trigger: Gate reads capsule summary text as truth.
preMortem.consequence: The feature worsens the process/fact fabrication risk it was meant to solve.
preMortem.mitigation: DONE gates ignore capsule prose; capsule validation checks refs and tests assert forged prose cannot satisfy gates.

preMortem.scenario: OMX import silently becomes a truth source.
preMortem.trigger: capsule_import_omx copies .omx facts without source/authority metadata.
preMortem.consequence: Volatile local runtime memory pollutes Koala authority state.
preMortem.mitigation: Imported records are marked source=omx_import and authority=non_authoritative; import output lives under capsule/imports and is display-only.

preMortem.scenario: Run transcript storage becomes too large or leaks private chat.
preMortem.trigger: capsule_run_add stores full conversation by default.
preMortem.mitigation: Persist concise command/result/error excerpts by default and require explicit artifact refs for larger material.
